mintAuthority.summary: GGBR is minted exclusively through the GoldfishTokenFactory contract (MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN held by a single issuer EOA). The GoldfishToken contract itself is administered by a 2-of-3 Safe that controls setMinterContract() and UUPS upgrades. Redemptions burn through the same factory.

controls.label: GoldfishTokenFactory (minterContract) — issuer EOA operator
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025, GoldfishToken storage slot 2 == 0x765c0af86952604f1576ca3b5beb75420d75ff62 (GoldfishTokenFactory ERC1967Proxy, impl GoldfishTokenFactory). The factory MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE are held by EOA 0xd22d50e306b439015a5b01be65bb8e7ebc0bc2f4 (eth_getCode = 0x). GoldfishToken.mint() requires msg.sender == minterContract; factory.issueTokens() requires MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE.

controls.label: GoldfishToken admin Safe — upgrade and minterContract rotation
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025, GoldfishToken DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by 0xd0022c3ed6a11bf6791ba2c9d0b394021a6096e4 (Blockscout: SafeProxy). getOwners() = 3 owners; getThreshold() = 2; getModulesPaginated() = sentinel only (no modules); guard slot = 0x0; fallbackHandler slot = 0xfd0732dc... (CompatibilityFallbackHandler); Safe VERSION() = 1.4.1. DEFAULT_ADMIN controls setMinterContract() and _authorizeUpgrade() on the token. Follow-up 2026-07-20: the 2-of-3 Safe address is 0xd0022c3ed6a11bf6791ba2c9d0b394021a6096e4 — getThreshold()=2 and getOwners() returns exactly the three recorded owner EOAs on Ethereum.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295025: GoldfishToken (ERC1967Proxy, UUPS) minterContract slot 2 == GoldfishTokenFactory proxy 0x765c0af86952604f1576ca3b5beb75420d75ff62. Factory MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN = EOA 0xd22d50e306b439015a5b01be65bb8e7ebc0bc2f4. Token DEFAULT_ADMIN = 2-of-3 Safe v1.4.1 (no modules). Mint path: EOA calls factory.issueTokens() which calls token.mint(). Safe holds token upgrade and minterContract rotation authority. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer-controlled roles can mint or replace the minter without an independent delay, while the sole-chain designated collateral wallet is continuously comparable with total GGBR supply.
